limitations: Full-parameter gradient tensors are not exposed by the native trainer; full-FT runs record exact per-step parameter trajectories and update norms, while gradient norms/digests are recorded for the LoRA arms.

Gradient accumulation, forced non-finite updates, bidirectional attention, grouped-query fallback and alternate head dimensions are not supported by this fixture and are not exercised here; the two-pass support gate is qualified in the Phase XVI receipt.

Mixed-precision loss drift is gated at the matched initial step against wmma::MIXED_VS_FP32_MAX_ABS; the full trajectory drift is reported because full-fine-tuning trajectories separate after the first optimizer update.
Performance is a single-device measurement on this RDNA3 part, not a cross-vendor throughput claim.
